title: Try these 5 things
description: A quick tour of the demo as {role}. Everything resets at 00:00 UTC.

owner.kpis: Click a chart on the overview to drill into the matching jobs
owner.approvals: Approve or reject a large part request
owner.audit: See who changed what in the audit log
owner.portal: Open the customer portal as a customer and request service
owner.settings: Change an approval threshold in operations settings

dispatcher.board: Drag a job from the queue onto a technician on the dispatch board
dispatcher.review: Review a request that came in through the customer portal
dispatcher.today: Check today's load and the jobs at risk on the Today tab
dispatcher.search: Search jobs and customers with ⌘K or Ctrl K
dispatcher.export: Filter the jobs list and export it as CSV

technician.myDay: See today's visits in My day on a phone-sized screen
technician.start: Tap En route, then Start on your next visit
technician.checklist: Tick the checklist and add a photo
technician.part: Request a part for a job
technician.complete: Capture the customer's signature and complete the job
